title: Missing coincidence/relevance lemma: [[T]]_ρ depends only on ρ↾FV(T)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The interpretation is asserted to depend only on the environments restriction to free variables, i.e. [[T]]_ρ = [[T]]_{ρ↾FV(T)}, but this is never stated or proved, yet it is load-bearing at THREE points:

1. Lemma (Substitution) lem:subst — explicitly: "we use that [[T]]_ρ depends only on ρ↾FV(T)"; and in the abstraction case via [[N]]_{ρ[z:=a]} = [[N]]_ρ since z∉FV(N).
2. Proposition (One-step decrease) prop:step — "Since FV(N)⊆FV(M), restricting ρ to FV(N) is legitimate."
3. Theorem thm:main — applies a single canonical environment ρ0 to both M and N when FV(N)⊆FV(M).

Status: GENUINE but MINOR. It is true and closable by a one-line structural induction on T (the recursion only ever reads ρ(x) for x∈FV(T)). A self-contained writeup should add it explicitly as a Coincidence Lemma and cite it at the three sites above.

Suggested statement: For every term T and environments ρ,ρ_2 with ρ(x)=ρ_2(x) for all x∈FV(T), one has [[T]]_ρ=[[T]]_{ρ_2}. Proof by induction on T: variable reads only ρ(x), x∈FV(T); application IH on both subterms; abstraction λz.P — for each argument a, ρ[z:=a] and ρ_2[z:=a] agree on FV(P), apply IH.
